reviews_h2: What people are saying about the painting

reviews.author: Ashley Kemnitz
reviews.text: Parlett’s Painting has done both our interior and exterior, and I can honestly say they are amazing. They are always on time, incredibly detailed, and go above and beyond to make sure everything is done right. If you’re looking for reliable, high-quality work, this is your team!

reviews.author: Gerald DeRoche
reviews.text: John Parlett was a god send. I just had the.entire house painted inside, outside, basement, garage and breezeway. He and his marvelous team were punctual, hardworking and very creative. They were amazing.

reviews.author: Krista Sweet
reviews.text: Parlett's Painting did a wonderful job refreshing the interior and exterior my Grandmother's home! All of the walls were repaired and painted, along with all interior doors. They even touched up the kitchen cabinetry and exhaust hood over the stove! The most amazing improvements were made to the garage, thanks to owner John Parlett's vision! The gray he selected for the front/side doors and shutters really help tie it all together! The power washing of the home's exterior greatly improved the overall look, too! It was a big job, but it was completed quickly and effectively. Big shout out and THANKS to the Parlett's Painting Team!

reviews.author: Jane Stanley
reviews.text: John Parlett & his crew are amazing! Not only did they do a fantastic job painting our home in Mathews, VA but they also flawlessly reconstructed sections of the original structure. Their main objective is ensuring that you are happy with their work. It can so difficult to find reliable, honest professionals who show up on time, keep you updated along the way and are genuinely friendly. What a breath of fresh air!!

reviews.author: MTRA Montgomery
reviews.text: The time had come to paint the interior of 3 rooms, and our hallway. My wife was adamant that we hire professional painters. After scoping out the amount of work, and time I would have to do to complete the task, I broke down, and agreed with her. We found Parlett Painting's website and found they were a local family business, so I gave them a call. I spoke with John, who said he'd be to our house the same day. John was polite, and very knowledgeable. He gave us a great estimate and stated we could begin work the next day, we couldn't resist, and requested they do our project. John's team arrived the following day, on time, and with enough painters to get the job done. All his team was professional, respectful of our property, and finished the job with excellent quality and precision. They repaired cracks and drywall flaws, and replaced a burnt out ceiling light...who does that?!..Parlett Painting does, that's who. If you want good quality painting, call Parlett. They were the answer to my wife's prayers, perhaps they will be yours as well.

reviews.author: Kerri Hummel
reviews.text: We have used Parlett Painting on two different painting/drywall projects in the past and were very pleased. We are extremely happy with the recent interior painting project on our daughters room. We received great communication from estimation to completion of job. John Parlett is very professional, friendly and responsive. The crew that came to our home worked quickly and professionally and did a great job! We will continue using them for future painting needs!

reviews.author: Steve Forte
reviews.text: Parlett painting did a fantastic job painting the exterior of my house, my master bedroom and the trim. They were on time each day and his crew were very professional. I appreciate the quality work that was provided and I would definitely hire them again. John Parlett was easy to work with. He was prompt with getting my estimate and scheduling the job. Very pleased overall. Thank you Parlett Painting. John: Five stars is what you and your team deserved.

reviews.author: Jessie Hillenbrand
reviews.text: I saw someone else's review asking if they can give Parlett Painting more than 5 stars. Yes, how do I do that!?! I would give them 10! John and his team were absolutely superb. My husband and I have worked with a lot of contractors over the years, and John and his team were communicative, professional, hard working and best of all, excellent at their craft. Probably the best contractor I've ever worked with. His team painted the entire interior of our home, top to bottom, bathroom to bedroom and all of our kitchen cabinets. Not only have they made our home look brand new, but it was an absolutely pleasure seeing them work. They were very respectful to our home and treated it like their own. From the moment I met John, he was honest, upfront and just an absolute pleasure to work with. I wholeheartedly recommend John and his team for any painting job you have. Next up, exterior of the house and our fence. I would not give the job to anyone but Parlett Painting.

reviews.author: Rachel Dickerson
reviews.text: We contacted Parlett Painting to remove the textured ceiling that was put up MANY years ago. The only negative I can say, is that we DID NOT call sooner. We called John early Thursday morning and he was there within 30 minutes and gave us a quote. We scheduled the team to start the following Monday and they finished Tuesday afternoon. John and his team were on time and very professional. The celing looks amazing. I wish I could give more than 5 stars. I can't wait to get the exterior done. Great job Parlett Painting. Thank you so very much!

reviews.author: Stacy Roach
reviews.text: Look no further for a company to help you with your painting projects! John Parlett and his crew can do it all and provide 5 star work. We used Parlett Painting for drywall repairs, interior painting, exterior door/shutter painting and cabinet painting. John’s costumer service, professionalism and pride in their work make Parlett Painting a company you have to use. John answered my initial call, was available within a week for a consultation, prepared a quote the same day and scheduled our project at time that was convenient to us. John’s crew was on time, respectful and professional. We made the mistake of buying our own paint and John’s crew never gave up! They worked until it was right. John was involved in the entire process and wouldn’t pull his crew until it met his standards (despite needing an additional day of work at no charge to us). John always answered the phone, texts and emails and stayed in constant contact throughout the process. I highly recommend Parlett Painting to anyone who needs these services. We have found our family’s painter for any further projects. Thank you John and the Parlett crew! We are so happy with everything you did for us!

reviews.author: Laurie Rowe
reviews.text: I cannot say enough about how happy we are with the work done by Parlett’s Painting. From the moment we got our quote to the moment they pulled out of the driveway was nothing but easy, and our house looks brand new in only a matter of a couple days. The guys were super nice and friendly, and they answered all of my questions and took care of everything I asked for. The crew seemed to be happy to be at the job each day and it showed in their quality of work. I would highly recommend them to my friends and family, and I will definitely use them again. Great people, great price, great work… great everything!

reviews.author: Martha Geuss
reviews.text: Parlett’s Painting did an amazing job! We had quite a bit of drywall work and the entire interior repainted. Meticulous! They also painted all the new trim on the exterior of our home. John and his crew are top-notch professionals and we highly recommend them!!!!

reviews.author: Louisa Shelton
reviews.text: John and his team of painters are like nothing my husband and I have ever experienced! John arrived to go over and double check all my painting decisions before his crew got started. His crew of painters immediately got to work. They all had a job, moving furniture, covering the floors and furniture, removing outlet covers etc. They repaired every crack in sheet rock, all nail holes. They were all very professional and a smile on every face. They cleaned up spotlessly, not one drop of paint on anything. I didn't even have to scrape paint off of windows! Call John for all your painting needs, they are the BEST

reviews.author: Jennifer Schuman
reviews.text: John & his team are just fantastic! They are quick, professional, detail oriented & they did an amazing job painting the interior of our home! John goes above & beyond to make sure his customers are 100% happy. All contractors should aspire to their level of customer service! If I ever need anything painted in the future, you can be sure we’ll be calling Parlett Painting!

reviews.author: Sarah Parsley
reviews.text: Parletts Painting did a great job on our upstairs. They were very professional, quick and did a great job. They even fixed a couple of additional areas for us and didn’t charge us. They made the job look easy! Will definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Sara Walden
reviews.text: John was incredibly responsive and patient with me as a first time home color chooser. He was thorough and checked in every day, making sure the crew was addressing additional needs. They arrived when they said they would and took the estimated amount of time, which was very efficient and fast. When there were some left over concerns, he was responsive and they were addressed the next day. The house looks like a completely different home, amazing. I should have asked for the decks to be sanded first but that is my fault. I would recommend deck sanding before painting (especially if you have dogs or heavy traffic). I would recommend John to others for house painting.

reviews.author: Pat Moynihan
reviews.text: John and his crew arrived on time, and ready to work. The team introduced themselves and got right to work. The transformation of my house was spectacular. All holes were filled, all trim was meticulously painted, and the cleanup was thorough. The next day a painter returned and did touch up work, even in spots I hadn’t noticed. I highly recommend Parlett Painting for any painting you might be considering.

reviews.author: Matthew W
reviews.text: From the first email for a quote to completion of job, professional all the way from start to finish. I was immediately impressed when John made appointment to come look at the house at 2:30 and text when he was 10 minutes out. Short conversation about what we wanted done and what he could do the job for. I knew he had a grasp on the job at hand. Showed up earlier than expected and ready to work. His crew was impressive and came to work. Parletts got done in a day and a half what would have taken me a week and a couple weekends! The energy John brings when he is on the job is unmatched. And when we had a small issue, he had his guys come back and fix it, next day, at no additional cost. Honored his commitment and exceeded all expectations. Few and far between are there companies that do the quality job with the integrity that Parletts brings. Highly recommend and will call him for any other paint jobs we have in the future. Top notch!

reviews.author: Debbie Legg
reviews.text: Once I decided to paint the brick on my home, I contacted John and he came by the next day to look at the house and give me a quote. He had some great ideas and seemed to really care about improving the look of my home. There were a few delays getting started mostly due to the weather but once they started, the job went quick, they cleaned up everything and left me with very satisfied with what looks like a totally different house. I’ve had people I don’t know stop by to tell me how incredible it looks. I would definitely recommend this company and give them 5 stars for service and job satisfaction!

reviews.author: John Carmack
reviews.text: John and his crews were outstanding. We needed external painting that was long overdue. John is high energy, detail oriented, and did great work for us in Kilmarnock. Most importantly, he showed up and started the work when he said he would and completed the work as he promised. We will have John back this winter for indoor work. If you want reliable high quality work from a painter who has attention to detail, John Parlett is your painter.

reviews.author: patricia crabtree
reviews.text: There are not enough stars. Parletts team of painters were amazing. They arrived on time and did an outstanding job painting our kitchen and living room area including ceilings. Worked a miracle on some 30 year old kitchen cabinets. They were polite and very professional. Will definitely call on them for future painting jobs. Patricia C

reviews.author: Jack Dos Santos
reviews.text: Parlett Painting strives for perfection. Prior to painting, they lay down protective paper on the floors. If the drywall needs repair, they make it as perfect as possible. The attention to detail displayed during painting is second to none. QA is carried out by all members of the team. Clean-up was exceptional as well. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dana Parlett
reviews.text: Parlett's painting has done all painting projects for my family members and friends. The whole crew is talented, professional, and knowledgeable about all of your painting needs. I highly recommend them for any exterior, interior, commercial, or residential painting project that you may need done in the future.

reviews.author: Ro B
reviews.text: Anyone who is looking for a paint company that does exceptional work should call Parlett Painting. Their prices are very reasonable and they do meticulous work. I have already made an appointment for them to do more work at my home. Call them. You won't be disappointed!

reviews.author: Dee Lightful
reviews.text: A very professional painting contractor with highly courteous and skilled employees. Their quality of work and following up with thoroughly cleaning the area exceeded my expectations. I recommend them for all your painting needs. You won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: ReNaye Dame
reviews.text: John is very professional..I am a Realtor and have recommended him to several clients. They've each been super pleased with his work. He goes above & beyond.. All around good guy. I will continue recommending him in the future.

reviews.author: Samantha Smith
reviews.text: The team of Parlett’s was great to work with. I hear people say the contractor/painter never called them back or show up. That was not the case with Parlett’s. They even came back to do a touch up that I caused. I will use them again for other projects.

reviews.author: Aletha Sangiray
reviews.text: Wonderful job painting interior of our home. Excellent service. They came out to give us a quote and were able to put us on the schedule and came out and finished the job. Very professional and efficient. Excellent quality. Recommend highly.

reviews.author: Krystal Blymyer
reviews.text: I’ve had them do work in both my home and business and couldn’t possibly be happier. Their professionalism, attention to detail and reliability can not be matched. I appreciate how quick to respond as well as how incredibly helpful John and his entire crew have always been and recommend them to any and everyone I come across.

reviews.author: Scott Magruder
reviews.text: Parlett painting was top notch. Don't hesitate to hire them. Professional, on time, efficient and all at a fair price. Look forward to using them in the future.

reviews.author: Hillary Callis
reviews.text: Parlett’s was amazing to work with! They always showed up on time and worked hard to get the job done around my strict time schedule. The quality of work was just a amazing! Highly impressed!

reviews.author: Kim Gregory
reviews.text: John and his crew were great! Our house looks awesome. Already getting estimates on future interior work with Parlett Painting.

reviews.author: Steve Barnette
reviews.text: It's very refreshing to have a company show up, not on time, but early. The whole crew was professional, talented, and efficient. The end product was OUTSTANDING. John went over everything with a critical eye and made some few corrections and voila...we are very very pleased.

reviews.author: Lisa Brewer
reviews.text: Parlett’s painting did a great job painting my home interior. Great guys and were very professional. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Cindy Fitchett
reviews.text: I have to say this company does exactly what they say they are going to do..They worked the entire time they were soft washing my house and decks..I could not believe before and after results..Next project hopefully will be interior painting..if you want reliable and trustworthy then Parlett Painting is who you need to call..and their work isn't limited to painting..

reviews.author: Mary Leunig
reviews.text: What can I say...Parlett painting was the right choice. Made the kitchen of my dreams a reality. Can't wait to have them back to do the LR & Dining room.

reviews.author: Adrian _reckless
reviews.text: Very reliable dependable and prices are reasonable....has painted numerous properties with always A1 perfection.....if your looking for perfection hes the guy for you....thanks for the awesome job... will definitely recommend to everyone I know

reviews.author: Betty Daniel
reviews.text: I called and it was a quick response to give me an estimate. This was 2 years ago. I texted and called 4 times and the last response was “I am so sorry. We will be there in the next 2 weeks”. THEY NEVER SHOWED.

reviews.author: kimmi 15
reviews.text: They just painted my whole house in two days. It couldn't have looked any better. Beautiful work!!!!

reviews.author: Stacy Otis
reviews.text: From the estimate to the clean up these guys were professional, efficient, and did an outstanding job!!!!

reviews.author: Robin Fletcher
reviews.text: The best prices, the most attention to detail, careful consideration and care for your home and passion to please their customers.
